title: North Dakota Century Code Chapter 47-16 - Leasing of Real Property
verified_how: fetched the register's Title 47 chapter index (https://ndlegis.gov/cencode/t47.html): title 'Title 47 - Property', chapter row '47-16' with name 'Leasing of Real Property', no '[Repealed]' marker; then fetched https://ndlegis.gov/cencode/t47c16.html, which lists sections from 47-16-01. Currency: 07/01/25 update, 69th Legislative Assembly.
notes: North Dakota has no separate residential landlord-and-tenant Act; residential tenancy (security deposits, habitability, notice to quit) is carried inside this general leasing chapter. Eviction procedure is ch. 47-32 (Eviction). General consumer protection is a different statute, N.D.C.C. ch. 51-15 (Consumer Fraud), not listed because only one statute per topic is recorded.
